description: Use this when a seller asks how a supplier's prices compare overall, by category, or against one other supplier: how many products it is the cheapest for, where it costs more, and by how much. Uses each product's usual configuration delivered to the destination; checkedAt is when that supplier's prices were last checked. For one product's prices, use compare_product.

category.description: Only this category, by id from list_categories, such as `mugs`.

categoryLimit.description: How many per-category tallies to return. 0 skips them.

currency.description: Currency for every price. Defaults to the destination's own currency.

destination.description: The buyer's country, where the order ships. Product cost, shipping and duty depend on it.

offset.description: How many results to skip. Pass nextOffset from the previous page.

pricingTier.description: base is each supplier's standard price; tier1 and tier2 are its paid plans.

search.description: Only products matching these words, such as `hoodie`.

supplierId.description: The supplier whose prices to rank, such as printify. list_suppliers lists them.

versus.description: Compare against this supplier only, instead of every other one.

within.description: How close to the cheapest still counts as near-cheapest.

amount.description: How far above the cheapest price still counts, in the response currency.

kind.description: Measure closeness as a fixed amount of money.
Measure closeness as a share of the cheapest price.

percent.description: How far above the cheapest price still counts, as a percent of it.

name: get_supplier_prices

cheaperElsewhere.description: How many where another supplier is cheaper.

cheapest.description: How many of them it wins outright, costing less than every other supplier.

medianLosingGap.description: The typical amount it loses by, in the response currency; null when it never loses.

medianWinningGap.description: The typical amount it wins by, in the response currency; null when it never wins.

nearCheapest.description: How many of those are within the near-cheapest amount.

tied.description: How many where it ties another supplier as cheapest.

cheaperElsewhere.description: Products where another supplier is cheaper, largest gap first.

canonicalProductId.description: The product's id, to pass to compare_product.

delivered.description: This supplier's delivered price, product plus shipping, in the response currency.

gap.description: How far apart the two delivered prices are, in the response currency, always positive.

option.description: The configuration both prices refer to.

otherDelivered.description: The other supplier's delivered price in the response currency; null when unknown.

otherSupplier.description: The other supplier's id; null when unknown.

url.description: The product's page on POD Benchmark; null when it has none.

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass for the next page; null on the last page.

totalCount.description: How many results match in total, across every page.

overview.description: The comparison across every product; null when unavailable.

status.description: ready when prices could be compared, unavailable when not.

error.description: The error this call returned instead of a result.

code.description: The machine-readable reason the call failed.

message.description: What went wrong, in words, and what to do next.

title: Where a supplier is cheapest
